home.title: Uroboros.Workbench
home.lead: A workbench for a developer and the agent that carries out their work. The person sets a task, the agent runs it over MCP, and everything the agent does shows up here as a page right away. The work stays in the database and outlives the agent's session.
home.hint: Sections are on the left. Start with a workspace: tasks live inside it.

mcp.title: Twenty-two tools
mcp.text: The agent connects over MCP and runs the work with them: creates tasks, writes the plan, closes stages, leaves journal entries. A ready-made connection config is on the “MCP servers” page.

workspace.title: The workspace is chosen once
workspace.text: It separates work from personal and one client from another. The agent names it when connecting, and after that no tool takes a workspace as an argument — there is nothing to get wrong in a single call.

evidence.title: A stage can't be closed with “done”
evidence.text: Closing requires a pointer to the proof: a command with its result, a file path, a diff summary. A step marked done without a trace makes every step after it reason on something nobody checked.

journal.title: The journal is append-only
journal.text: Decisions, findings and facts stay as written: an entry can be closed once and never rewritten. Changed your mind — that is a new entry, not an edit of the old one.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This page doesn't seem to exist, or it has been moved.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: This section isn't available to you right now. Go back or open the home page.

failure.title: Something broke
failure.description: A failure on our side. Try again — if that doesn't help, restart the server.

offline.title: No connection to the server
offline.description: The app couldn't reach the backend. Check that the server is running and try again.

errors.stage_evidence_required: A stage can't be closed without evidence: say what proves it is done — a command and its result, a file path, a diff summary.
errors.note_already_resolved: The entry is already closed. The journal is append-only: if the decision has changed, add a new entry.
errors.timeout: The server didn't respond in time
errors.protocol: The server's response isn't what the app expects
errors.throttled: Too many requests — wait a moment
errors.throttled_wait: Too many requests — try again in {seconds} s
